# Intune Documentation

> Intune Documentation is a free, read-only web application that creates audit-ready PDF and Word documentation from Microsoft Intune configurations.

## Primary pages

- [Product overview](https://intunedocumentation.com/): Features, security model, supported configuration areas, workflow, and frequently asked questions.
- [Compliance evidence](https://intunedocumentation.com/compliance): Framework mapping for ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, SOC 2, the HIPAA Security Rule, NIST, BSI IT-Grundschutz, Def Stan 05-138, Cyber Essentials, and ASD Essential Eight.
- [Desktop app](https://intunedocumentation.com/desktop): Paid macOS and Windows app that collects Intune configuration locally with your own Entra app registration, with Word and PDF exports, compliance evidence, a management report, and search across every collected setting.
- [Documentation](https://docs.intunedocumentation.com): Guides for the web app and the desktop app: setup, app registration, license, collection, Search settings, exports, compliance evidence, management report, troubleshooting, and self-hosting. Full index at https://docs.intunedocumentation.com/llms.txt.
- [Privacy policy](https://intunedocumentation.com/privacy-policy): Data access, transient processing, redaction, analytics, retention, and user rights.
- [Sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/api/pdf/sample): Example of the generated documentation format.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ugurkocde/IntuneDocumentation): Application source, setup instructions, and self-hosting documentation.
- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/ugurkocde/IntuneDocumentation#self-host-with-docker): Run the application with your own Microsoft Entra registration.
- [Product changelog](https://changelog.ugurlabs.com): Public release and improvement history.
- [About Ugurlabs](https://ugurlabs.com/about): Information about the organization maintaining the service.

Short PDF excerpts of compliance evidence reports for the fictional tenant Contoso Ltd. Overview: [Sample reports](https://intunedocumentation.com/compliance#samples).

- [ISO/IEC 27001:2022 sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/iso-27001-2022.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [NIS2 Directive sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/nis2.pdf): Evidence report excerpt. NIS2 reports are created in the desktop app only.
- [SOC 2 sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/soc2.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [HIPAA Security Rule sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/hipaa-security-rule.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [NIST SP 800-53 sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/nist-800-53-r5.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [NIST SP 800-171 sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/nist-800-171-r3.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [NIST CSF 2.0 sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/nist-csf-2.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [Cyber Essentials sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/cyber-essentials.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [ASD Essential Eight sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/essential-eight-ml1.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.
- [BSI IT-Grundschutz sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/bsi-it-grundschutz.pdf): Evidence report excerpt, in German.
- [Def Stan 05-138 sample report](https://intunedocumentation.com/samples/def-stan-05-138.pdf): Evidence report excerpt.

## Important facts

- The hosted application uses delegated, read-only Microsoft Graph permissions.
- Microsoft Graph responses are processed transiently and are not persisted as tenant configuration data.
- Sensitive values are redacted before dashboard display or document export.
- PDF and Word documents are generated in the user's browser.
- The project can be self-hosted with telemetry disabled by default.
